name: Lee Siu Kai (李兆佳)
sen_type: Attention Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder (AD/HD) / 專注力不足/過度活躍症

current_performance.strengths_and_interests: Has a good memory. Shows curiosity in learning. Enjoys extra-curricular activities. / 記憶力良好，對學習具好奇心，喜歡參與課外活動。
current_performance.weaknesses: Gets distracted easily, sustains attention for only 4-5 minutes. Weak in impulse-control. / 上課容易分心，專注力僅維持4至5分鐘。衝動控制較弱。

learning_adjustment.tier_1_support: Use visual cue cards consistently. Break tasks into small 5-minute segments. Reduce written assignments to 60%. / 使用視覺提示卡，將學習任務拆解為5分鐘的小節，減少抄寫功課量至60%。
learning_adjustment.tier_2_and_3_support: Devise an individualized reward plan for task completion. / 設立個人化的完成任務獎勵計劃。

social_behavioral_adjustment.tier_1_support: Adopt 'Three Principles of Interpersonal Interactions'. Increase paired-work. / 採用「人際互動三原則」，增加小組配對工作。
social_behavioral_adjustment.tier_2_and_3_support: Role-play social scenarios in individual sessions. / 透過個別輔導進行社交情境角色扮演。

name: Chan Ka Ming (陳家明)
sen_type: Specific Learning Difficulties (SpLD) / 特殊學習困難 (讀寫障礙)

current_performance.strengths_and_interests: Strong verbal communication skills. Creative and enjoys visual arts. / 口語表達能力強，具創意，喜歡視覺藝術。
current_performance.weaknesses: Slow reading speed. Struggles with text-heavy math word problems. Frequently reverses numbers (e.g., 12 and 21). / 閱讀速度慢，難以理解多字的數學應用題，常寫反數字。

learning_adjustment.tier_1_support: Read word problems aloud. Use Concrete-Pictorial-Abstract (CPA) models. Enlarge text size on worksheets. / 朗讀應用題，使用「具體-圖像-抽象」模型，放大工作紙字體。
learning_adjustment.tier_2_and_3_support: Small group remedial reading and structural decoding training. / 小組抽離進行閱讀及拆字訓練。

social_behavioral_adjustment.tier_1_support: Provide frequent positive reinforcement to build self-esteem. / 提供頻密的正向鼓勵以建立自信心。

name: Cheung Siu Ling (張少玲)
sen_type: Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) / 自閉症譜系障礙

current_performance.strengths_and_interests: Strong visual-spatial reasoning. Strictly follows routines and clear rules. / 視覺空間邏輯強，能嚴格遵守常規和清晰指示。
current_performance.weaknesses: Struggles with abstract concepts and sudden changes in lesson flow. Weak peer interactions. / 難以理解抽象概念及突發的課堂流程轉變，同儕互動較弱。

learning_adjustment.tier_1_support: Provide explicit visual schedules before class. Give clear, step-by-step instructions. / 課前提供清晰的視覺日程，給予明確、循序漸進的指示。
learning_adjustment.tier_2_and_3_support: Social stories training for classroom transitions. / 運用社交故事訓練適應課堂轉換。

social_behavioral_adjustment.tier_1_support: Assign a fixed, predictable role during group work. / 在小組工作時分配固定、可預測的角色。
social_behavioral_adjustment.tier_2_and_3_support: Join social skills training group. / 參加社交技巧訓練小組。
